origin: Own exact age-dependent branching model of anonymous dividing cells. LabelsF/S are abstract heritable timing states, not organisms, genes, constructs or experimental interventions. All readouts are constructed exact marginal probabilities, not finite-sample biological measurements. No sequence or laboratory procedure is provided.
single_daughter_readout: For a parent of typei, exactly one uniformly selected daughter has true typej with probabilityP_ij. Known classifier responseM has rows[A,B],columns[F,S], M=[[0.9,0.2],[0.1,0.8]]. The CSV gives y_i=M*(P_iF,P_iS)^T, using every channel of every parent. Recover the full2x2row-stochasticP using actual SolveLinearSystem for EACH parent; validate all probabilities and both marginal readouts. The source contains no paired-sister observation.
branching_clock: A newborn F cell divides after exactly T_F=1 clock unit; newborn S after exactly T_S=2. Each parent disappears at division and is replaced by exactly2 daughters, each newborn. Conditional single-daughter marginal isP for each of the two ordered daughters. Their JOINT types may have any exchangeable coupling compatible with those marginals, including conditional independence or perfect correlation; different parental families use independent draws. There is no death, growth arrest, density feedback, immigration, observation loss or extra type. A cell keeps its type until division. This is a timing/sampling model only.
census_convention: At integer timet take the census immediately AFTER all divisions due at that time. Stage order[F0,S0,S1]: newbornF aged0, newbornS aged0, andS aged1. Starting at t=0 with one newbornF means column state[1,0,0]. Derive the complete3x3first-moment census operatorL from recoveredP and timing, with column-state update n(t+1)=L*n(t). Retain actual MatrixMultiply of L*L and of (actual L*L)*L; verify the propagated actual outputs, then give expected total census at t=[0,1,2,3,6]. Do not substitute a2x2daughter-generation operator for the chronological census.
growth_and_modes: Derive the complete characteristic polynomial ofL and retain actual PolynomialRoots for EVERY complex/real root. Select admissible stable growth using positive populations and Perron theory, not merely a positive characteristic root. Return all characteristic roots ascending (they are real for this source), number of positive characteristic roots and number of biologically positive stable growth laws. Give multiplicationrho per clock unit, natural-loggrowthlambda=logrho and doubling time. Identify the leading relative relaxation multiplier of normalized expected stage counts and whether relaxation alternates in sign. Explain why any other positive root fails to define a nonnegative stable census.
five_sampling_schemes: Compare(i) a CHRONOLOGICAL lineage that follows one uniformly selected daughter at each division, sampled by division index;(ii) newborn birth flux in the growing population;(iii) a uniformly sampled living cell at integer census time, with both stage and type probabilities;(iv) the parent type among divisions occurring in an integer update;(v) ancestral types along the genealogy of a uniformly sampled far-future cell, sampled by ancestral DIVISION index. For(v) also report ancestor-type time occupancy, which weights each ancestral cycle by its duration. Derive normalized weights for all schemes, distinguishing birth rate from live-cell prevalence. Any coincidence for these particular parameters must not be asserted as a universal identity.
ancestral_transport: Construct the positive renewal kernel K_ij(lambda)=2*exp(-lambda*T_i)*P_ij. Let b be its left eigenvector b^T*K=b^T normalized sum b=1, and h its right eigenvector K*h=h normalized sum_i b_i*h_i=1. In the reporting convention b is written as a column list. Retain actual SolveLinearSystem for b and for h using all renewal equations plus the appropriate normalization, allowing consistent rectangular least squares. Derive BOTH stochastic matrices: backward ancestor transition has rows CURRENT typej and columns PARENT typei; retrospective forward transition has rows PARENT typei and columns CHILD typej. Audit their row sums, positive stationary law and time-reversal relation using actual MatrixMultiply on the transported2x2operators where useful. Similar numerical matrices here do not eliminate the need to derive their orientations.
histogram_competitor_and_sensitivity: Construct a second model with exactly the sameF/Sdurations and same chronological stationary type marginal, but each row of its daughterP equals that stationary marginal: successive cycle types along a chronological lineage are then iid. Derive its full renewal polynomial, retain actual PolynomialRoots, and return its physically positive growth rate. Compare with both the heritable model and the tempting log(2)/chronological-mean-duration shortcut. Prove why a stationary chronological duration histogram is insufficient to determine growth under inheritance. For the ORIGINAL heritable model compute partial derivatives d(lambda)/d(T_F),d(lambda)/d(T_S) treating durations as continuously variable in the age-dependent renewal equation near[1,2], withP fixed. Do not differentiate a fixed integer-stage matrix dimension. Also compute d(lambda)/d(logm) at expected daughter numberm=2 in K=m*exp(-lambda*T_i)*P_ij. Here varyingm is a mathematical sensitivity only. Explain why retrospective rather than ordinary chronological cycle weights enter these derivatives; independently check the derivatives by re-solving the perturbed renewal equation.
unidentified_sisters: For one newbornF at t=0, derive the exact random total-cell count N(2) after divisions at t=2. The single-daughter readouts identify its mean but do not specify the conditional sister coupling. Enumerate the FOUR ordered sister outcomes[FF,FS,SF,SS], retaining nonnegative joint weights with total1 and BOTH daughter-F marginals equal to recovered P_FF. Derive sharp attainable lower/upper variance bounds over this entire coupling polytope. Retain TWO actual SolveLinearProgram calls minimizing/maximizing E[(number ofF sisters)^2] with the complete equality constraints and nonnegative bounds; propagate actual objectives and audit a feasible extremizer for each bound. Independently justify sharpness analytically, not only by a grid or reported solver status. Return also the variances under conditionally independent and perfectly correlated sisters. State precisely which mean/normalized-ancestry conclusions are fixed by one-daughter marginals and which finite-clone fluctuations remain unidentified. Sibling correlation cannot be inferred from an unpaired table.

interpretation_proposals.A: The same chronological cycle-duration histogram can coexist with different population growth when intergenerational type dependence differs.
interpretation_proposals.B: Any positive root of the full census characteristic polynomial supplies a biologically admissible stable growing population.
interpretation_proposals.C: Retrospective ancestry is biased by reproductive value and exponential growth, so a randomly followed daughter lineage is not an ancestral sample from a large future census.
interpretation_proposals.D: A single-daughter marginal table identifies the variance of finite-clone size because every parent has exactly two daughters.
interpretation_proposals.E: A2x2generation transition counts chronological divisions correctly even when different types have different deterministic cycle times.
interpretation_proposals.F: Unknown sister correlation can alter clonal fluctuation without altering the linear first-moment renewal operator.
interpretation_proposals.G: A parameter coincidence between chronological and live-cell type fractions proves equality for every age-dependent branching model.
interpretation_proposals.H: A negative subleading census mode can cause alternating relaxation without negative physical cell numbers.

reporting: Use the supplied answer schema. Ordered type arrays[F,S], stage arrays[F0,S0,S1], sister outcomes[FF,FS,SF,SS]. Characteristic roots sorted ascending; all probability vectors and stochastic rows normalized within1e-8 and components in[0,1], without relaxed physical bounds. Numeric answer tolerance1e-7absolute except expected census and sensitivities1e-6. Counts, booleans and proposal IDs exact; proposal order irrelevant. Derivations, positivity/exclusion proofs, both sister-coupling extremizers, native matrix/LP outputs and finite-difference re-solves belong in the trajectory, not extra final nesting.
